serverInfo.name: primus-digital-info
serverInfo.title: Primus Digital — Agency Info
serverInfo.description: Read-only MCP server for Primus Digital, a digital studio in Zagazig, Sharqia, Egypt. Exposes the four disciplines, the engagement types and how each is quoted, published proof, contact channels, and a WhatsApp inquiry-link builder. No prices are served: every engagement is scoped, then quoted.

tools.name: get_engagements
tools.description: List the four engagement types and how each is quoted. No price list.

tools.name: get_proof
tools.description: List published proof: one SaaS platform built end to end, two anonymised Measured Audits.

tools.name: get_services
tools.description: List core and exclusive services plus areas served.

tools.name: get_contact_options
tools.description: Get WhatsApp, email, and social contact channels.

tools.name: get_inquiry_link
tools.description: Build a prefilled WhatsApp link for the free page-audit flow.
